description: Implementation of LwM2mClientContext interface managing LwM2mClient instances, registration, session handling, power modes, and profile updates within the Thingsboard LwM2M transport server.

classes.name: LwM2mClientContextImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LwM2mClientContext interface managing clients, registration, session, and profile updates.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the client context by fetching existing clients from store and updating internal maps.

methods.name: getClientByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a new LwM2mClient based on endpoint.

methods.name: updateFetchedClient
methods.description: Updates internal maps and session registration for a fetched client.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles client registration, security info, and state transition to REGISTERED.

methods.name: asleep
methods.description: Marks a client as sleeping and logs the event.

methods.name: awake
methods.description: Marks a client as awake, triggers message sending after sleep, and logs the event.

methods.name: compareAndSetSleepFlag
methods.description: Sets the sleep flag for a client if conditions are met, considering power mode.

methods.name: updateRegistration
methods.description: Updates registration info and ensures client is awake.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a client, removes from maps, and updates profiles.

methods.name: getClientBySessionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves a client based on session info.

methods.name: getObjectIdByKeyNameFromProfile
methods.description: Gets object ID from profile based on key name.

methods.name: getRegistration
methods.description: Returns registration object for a given registration ID.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Initializes a client with credentials and updates profile.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates client data in store if in REGISTERED state.

methods.name: sendMsgsAfterSleeping
methods.description: Sends updates and messages to client after waking up.

methods.name: getPowerMode
methods.description: Retrieves the power mode for a client, considering profile settings.

methods.name: getLwM2mClients
methods.description: Returns all managed clients.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves profile configuration for a registration.

methods.name: doGetAndCache
methods.description: Fetches and caches profile configuration by profile ID.

methods.name: profileUpdate
methods.description: Updates profile cache with new device profile data.

methods.name: getSupportedIdVerInClient
methods.description: Returns supported object IDs and versions in client registration.

methods.name: getClientByDeviceId
methods.description: Finds client by device UUID.

methods.name: isDownlinkAllowed
methods.description: Determines if downlink is allowed based on power mode and last uplink time.

methods.name: onUplink
methods.description: Handles uplink event, updates last uplink time, and manages sleep state.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Calculates request timeout based on power mode and profile settings.
